OBSERVATION on D-067: the assignment says its unreproduced setup failure was 'later attributed to port collisions and fixed by F-DG2-310'. The records say the opposite: F-DG2-310's 'actual' states that the EADDRINUSE mechanism 'does NOT explain the orchestrator's D-067 symptom'. The symptom has not recurred in the 8 round-17 integration runs I examined (612/612 and 652/652). No specialist raised it, so it is not blocking.
D-077 residual: ACCEPTABLE as declared. It needs another tab of the same browser to sign a different person in within 2 s of tab 1's last /me. What can show is the new cookie holder's own server-authorised data under the previous header. Writes carry the old CSRF token and are refused. It ends at the next navigation, refocus, or GET after 2 s. qa R17-04c shows the worst case, B landing on A's organisation URL (an opaque id) with 'no permission' and no name or code. All three closing specialists challenged it with their own probes and accepted it. None raised a finding.
